mapper.select: select * from Stylist_Schedules where stylist_id = #{stylistId} and date >= CURDATE() order by date, start_time
select * from Stylist_Schedules where stylist_id = #{stylistId} and date = #{date}
mapper.insert: insert into Stylist_Schedules (stylist_id, date, start_time, end_time, is_available) values (#{stylistId}, #{date}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{isAvailable})
mapper.delete: delete from Stylist_Schedules where stylist_id = #{stylistId} and date >= CURDATE() and start_time = '00:00:00' and end_time = '23:59:00' and is_available = 0
